target.title: feat(android): add cron job management controls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android currently surfaces gateway cron jobs as status/detail information, but cron operators still need to switch back to another client to run, pause, edit, or remove scheduled work. This PR makes the Android settings cron surface actionable so mobile users can manage gateway cron jobs from the same place they inspect them.

## Summary

- Adds Android Settings cron-job management controls to inspect, run now, enable/disable, edit, and delete gateway cron jobs.
- Extends cron detail parsing to retain editable schedule, payload, session target, wake mode, and run-history metadata.
- Adds an Android cron screenshot scene for the new management surface without adding a permanent proof workflow to this PR.

## Implementation notes

- Keeps the existing cron list/detail request guard and extends it with run history plus action state.
- Sends mutations through gateway RPCs: `cron.run`, `cron.update`, `cron.remove`, and `cron.runs`.
- Updates Android native i18n source entries and Android docs for the new screenshot scene.
- Removes the branch-specific Android cron proof workflow from the PR; current proof is linked from `snowzlmbot/openclaw` GitHub Actions instead of adding that workflow to upstream.

## Evidence

Current head: `8c5b8d3f4f8426eb86f48e681c48312982500066`.

Local lightweight checks on the current head:

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` ✅
- `bash -n scripts/android-screenshots.sh` ✅
- `pnpm exec tsx scripts/native-app-i18n.ts check` ✅ (`entries=2868 changed=false`)

GitHub Actions proof:

- Android Cron Management Proof: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/29016362491 ✅ passed. The run log checks out the latest PR head `8c5b8d3f4f8426eb86f48e681c48312982500066`, then builds the Android APK, runs the cron mutation proof, and captures the cron screenshot scene.
- Uploaded artifacts from that run:
  - `openclaw-android-cron-mutation-proof` — `NodeRuntimeCronMutationTest`, `tests=2`, `failures=0`, `errors=0`; covers admin-scoped `cron.run`, `cron.update`, `cron.remove`, and the non-admin `operator.admin` guard.
  - `openclaw-android-cron-management-screenshot` — screenshot scene artifact for the Android cron management surface.
  - `openclaw-android-cron-management-apk` — APK artifact from the same proof run.
- The earlier canonical `android-ktlint` failure was fixed by `c0c72efa83c10213c2cf9d519355485884554e16` by extracting the chained assertion in `NodeRuntimeCronMutationTest.kt`.

Current validation gap:

- A fresh canonical upstream `CI / android-ktlint` job is not attached to the latest head at this update. If maintainers require canonical CI proof in addition to the current-head Actions proof above, that remains pending a maintainer-triggered upstream CI run.

## Risk and rollback

- Risk is limited to the Android settings cron-management surface and the screenshot scene support.
- Cron mutation RPCs remain gated on admin operator access; the current proof covers both the admin mutation path and the non-admin guard path.
- The branch-specific proof workflow was removed from this PR, so merging no longer adds that workflow to the upstream repository.
- Rollback is straightforward: revert this PR to restore the prior read-only cron detail UI. No data migration or irreversible configuration change is required.
